text: Testing plays a key role in building reliable software. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts work together. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. When tests pass, developers feel more confident that their changes have not broken anything. This confidence is important, because it allows teams to improve and update software quickly without fear of making serious mistakes.
